about.title: About Me
about.sub-text: Full-stack developer focused on front-end engineering, complex integrations, and technical ownership. Since joining AItenders, I've grown from an intern into owning key product areas, shaping technical decisions, and delivering features across the React, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot stack. From building a performance-sensitive Microsoft Word add-in to modernizing an established platform, I enjoy solving challenging problems through research, thoughtful engineering, and a focus on long-term maintainability.
experience.first.description: Focus on front-end engineering and the continuous evolution of the company's core platform, combining hands-on development with technical ownership and architectural decision-making.
experience.first.title: Full-Stack Developer
experience.first.sub-details-1: Technical ownership: Act as the primary developer responsible for the technical direction of a Microsoft Word add-in, making implementation decisions and evaluating trade-offs to ensure maintainability and performance.
experience.first.sub-details-2: Platform modernization: Initiate and drive improvements, including gradual TypeScript adoption, internationalization, architectural refactoring, and performance optimization.
experience.first.sub-details-3: Technical discovery: Research complex or unfamiliar problems, assess risks, and validate potential solutions before implementation.
experience.first.sub-details-4: Engineering practices: Explore effective ways to integrate AI into development workflows and share findings through internal technical articles.
experience.first.sub-details-5: Mentorship: Support interns and fellow developers through technical guidance, thoughtful code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving. Encourage independent thinking by helping developers approach problems from different perspectives rather than simply providing answers, while fostering a supportive and welcoming team environment.
experience.second.description: Developed a Microsoft Word add-in integrating with the company's core platform, working across front-end and back-end components.
experience.second.title: Full-Stack Development Intern
experience.second.sub-details-1: Built application features using React and Office.js, with Java and Spring Boot on the back end.
experience.second.sub-details-2: Investigated performance challenges in a complex integration where existing documentation offered limited guidance.
experience.second.sub-details-3: Researched and evaluated alternative implementation approaches to address technical constraints and improve performance.
experience.third.description: Contributed to the core platform by developing an activity historization feature, working across the front end and back end.
experience.third.title: Front-End Development Intern
experience.third.sub-details-2: Integrated front-end components with Java and Spring Boot services.
experience.third.sub-details-3: Delivered new functionality within an existing application, gaining experience in full-stack development and production software practices.
